insights.one_liner: Maker of Mentos, Chupa Chups and Fruittella, a recognised visa sponsor with an English-language senior IT role in Breda.

culture.text: Privately owned candy and chewing gum maker selling in over 150 countries, with brands like Mentos, Chupa Chups, Fruittella, Frisk and Smint.
Ranks itself the third-largest sugar confectionery and gum company in the world and second in Europe.
Had about 14,412 employees in 2022, headquartered in Schiphol-Rijk.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Perfetti Van Melle Business Support B.V. and Perfetti Van Melle Services B.V.

growth.text: Announced a switch to non-artificial colours in its products.
Launched a range of new gum and mint products.

worth_knowing.text: Ultimately owned by C+F Confectionery and Foods S.A., based in Luxembourg.
